steps.en: Install Pillow and clone the repo
Run the script with an image path (or an http/https URL) as its one argument
steps.zh: 运行脚本，唯一的参数是图片路径（或 http/https 网址）

steps.en: Shrinks the picture to 100 characters wide, keeping its proportions, and turns it grey
steps.zh: 把图缩到 100 个字符宽、保持比例，再转成灰度

steps.en: Sorts every pixel's brightness into 11 buckets and swaps it for one character, from @ (dark) to . (light)
steps.zh: 把每个像素按亮度分进 11 档，换成一个字符：最暗 @，最亮 .

steps.en: Prints the text picture and also writes it to img.txt in the current directory
steps.zh: 把文字画打印出来，同时写进当前目录的 img.txt

value.en: A picture becomes plain text you can paste into a terminal banner or a README
value.zh: 一张图变成纯文本，能直接贴进终端欢迎语或 README

sources: https://github.com/RameshAditya/asciify#how-to-use-asciify (pip install pillow; clone; pass the image path; prints and writes img.txt)
